label: rejected

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter views read as a flat paved tile/patio slab; silhouette is a low rectangular block, roof slope only readable from the gable-end close-up.
evidence.V2: Shingle courses and timber fascia only; no ridge, drip edge or small accents.
evidence.V3: Very shallow slope with flat paving-like slates that do not overlap; looks like a stiff floor piece rather than a stylised roof.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on every slate and on the fascia board (eave close-up).
evidence.V5: Eave, gable end and shingle close-ups shade cleanly; no pinches, seams or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Stone greys in 3 values + timber brown + cream gable strip; disciplined.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, stone + timber + cream plaster per modular rules, matches RoofPeak shingles.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Default collision (walkable), CanTouch off, grid-corner pivot, white MeshPart; T1 tiling pass.

top_fixes: Increase pitch or make slates visibly overlap (lapped, tilted courses) so the piece reads as roof, not floor
Add a drip edge / overhang at the eave to break the slab silhouette
Add a small accent (ink nails or gold trim) for small-scale detail
